articles.title: Andrew Tate and brother arrested in US after more charges laid against them in UK
articles.description: The Crown Prosecution Service says it has requested their extradition from the US, while their lawyer says they are "innocent".

articles.title: Burnham to scrap digital ID to focus on cost of living in first major policy pledge
articles.description: A spokesperson for the incoming prime minister says his government would “put its focus where people need it right now”.

articles.title: Can new PM's casual style survive contact with No 10?
articles.description: When Burnham becomes PM, he'll find it harder to wear the wardrobe that's central to his political brand.

articles.title: US and Iran exchange strikes after two US deaths in Jordan attack
articles.description: US forces target Iranian sites for the eighth night in a row, while Iran says it fired drones at the US military in Kuwait.
